question: What percentage of packed shoes did I wear on my last trip?

arms.A:
Based on your earlier message, you mentioned:

> "I packed a lot of shoes for my last trip, but I ended up only wearing two - my sneakers and sandals."

Since you packed 5 pairs of shoes (as mentioned in a previous message) and only wore 2, the percentage of packed shoes you actually wore is:

**(2 worn / 5 packed) × 100 = 40%**

So, you wore 40% of the shoes you packed on your last trip.
